# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK_SWEEP_TOP

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We aim to improve the SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trigger's edge on J winner days by adjusting volume, body, and break confirmation parameters while maintaining strict risk controls. The edge exists because default parameters may misalign with the specific volatility and structure of J's profitable put days.

## Mechanism

Trigger fires when: volume > 1.3× average volume, candle body > $0.05, ≥2 consecutive closes in break direction, strike offset = 2 (OTM puts), proximity to level ≤ $1.50, and break above open (for put context, this may require re-evaluation). Exit: 8% premium stop, 40% TP1 (sell 2/3), 150% runner target, profit lock armed immediately at 0% profit with 5% stop offset, qty=10.

## Pre-merge gate

Stage-1 backtest must show edge_capture ≥ 771 (OP-16 floor), walk-forward OOS positive with WF ≥ 0.70, real-fills validation <20% diff on top 3 J days, and concentration analysis showing top5_pct < 200%.

## Confidence

2/10 -- edge_capture (229.63) is far below OP-16 floor (771), indicating minimal J winner capture despite avoiding loser-day losses.
